verdict.rationale: SigNoz describes itself as an OpenTelemetry-native platform. Apps instrumented with standard OpenTelemetry libraries export over OTLP and SigNoz stores the data, and it also ingests from OTel SDK logs and existing Prometheus setups. Its Datadog migration guide supports incremental, parallel-running moves and offers a Datadog Receiver bridge, which points to backend switching without re-instrumenting. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement or guide on vendor-neutral portability (for example, switching away from SigNoz using the same OTel instrumentation), detailed OTLP/collector configuration docs in the pack, and independent hands-on corroboration of a backend swap.
